description:
Expose one deterministic index permutation for numeric reliability magnitudes plus an `Llr` convenience surface.

## Background

ORBGRAND and Chase-Pyndiah sort reliability indices privately from different input representations. The core helper accepts an `f32` magnitude slice so `Llr` and raw soft-value consumers share one total-order convention.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Returns each input index exactly once under the total order on magnitude and original index.
- [hard] REQ-02: Provides ascending and descending accessors that retain ascending original-index ties in either magnitude direction.
- [hard] REQ-03: Orders infinite magnitudes naturally and documents a panic for any NaN magnitude.
- [hard] REQ-04: Provides an `Llr` wrapper that delegates through `Llr::magnitude()` to the `f32` primitive.
- [hard] REQ-05: Covers empty, singleton, repeated-magnitude, signed-zero, infinite, and NaN cases with public rustdoc and property tests.
title: Canonical reliability permutation API
